verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of configurable alerts that notify via chat or email when specific conditions are met. The docs mention performance and behavior tracking (netlify-docs-17), but tracking is an adjacent observability feature, not alerting. A community comment refers vaguely to a 'GitHub/Slack integration' without describing condition-based notifications, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
